description.value: Shaughnessy's Cove is a premium casual lakeside restaurant on South Lakeshore Drive in Summerland, operated by Mackenzie Hospitality Group since a full gut-and-rebuild renovation in 2021. The space carries nearly 35 years of history under the 'Cove' name and features a heated patio with lake views. It serves lunch, dinner, and weekend brunch, and accommodates walk-ins as well as reservations.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully accessible and confirms the restaurant is active and operating. The website lists the address as '12817 Lakeshore Drive South, Summerland, BC' — same street number as OSM but specifies Summerland, while OSM's community field says Naramata; this geographic discrepancy is flagged. Phone number matches between OSM and website. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, takeout) are mentioned anywhere on the website, so those are all null per evidence rules.
concerns: OSM community field says 'Naramata' but the website consistently lists the city as 'Summerland, BC' — the correct municipality should be verified.
OSM opening_hours (closes 22:00–23:00) differ from website hours (closes 20:30–21:00); website hours appear more current and OSM tags may be outdated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant with a confirmed website, operating hours, and reservation system. Located on a scenic lakeshore drive and useful to touring cyclists in the Summerland/Naramata area.

wow_evidence: nearly 35 years of history under the 'Cove' name... heated patio with lake views
